nodes.name: fastapi
nodes.summary: A Python web framework for building APIs from standard type hints: it subclasses Starlette for the ASGI layer and uses Pydantic to validate requests and shape responses, and generates an OpenAPI schema and interactive docs for free.

nodes.name: Application & CLI
nodes.summary: The FastAPI application object (a Starlette subclass) that collects routes, builds the middleware stack and serves the OpenAPI schema, plus the command-line entry point.
nodes.detail: fastapi/applications.py defines the FastAPI class: it holds a root APIRouter, registers path operations through the get/post/put/... decorators, builds its ASGI middleware stack lazily, caches the generated OpenAPI document and mounts the docs routes in setup(). fastapi/cli.py is a thin shim that delegates to the separately installed fastapi-cli package for the `fastapi dev` and `fastapi run` commands. The package __init__ re-exports the public API (FastAPI, APIRouter, Depends, the parameter functions, Request, Response, and the WebSocket types).

nodes.name: Routing & execution
nodes.summary: Turns each path operation into an ASGI handler: matches the request, solves its dependencies, calls the endpoint, serializes the result and runs any background tasks.
nodes.detail: fastapi/routing.py is the engine. APIRouter collects APIRoute and APIWebSocketRoute objects; get_request_handler builds the per-route coroutine that validates parameters, runs the endpoint (sync endpoints are pushed to a threadpool via fastapi/concurrency.py), serializes the response through serialize_response and sends it. It also carries the newer included-router and frontend static-file routing used for mounting sub-apps and single-page apps. fastapi/background.py exposes BackgroundTasks for work that runs after the response, and fastapi/websockets.py re-exports Starlette's WebSocket types.

nodes.name: Parameters & dependency injection
nodes.summary: Reads each endpoint's type-hinted signature into a tree of dependencies and parameters, then resolves that tree per request.
nodes.detail: fastapi/param_functions.py provides the Query/Path/Header/Cookie/Body/Form/File/Depends/Security markers an endpoint uses in its signature; fastapi/params.py holds the Param model classes behind them. fastapi/dependencies/utils.py is the core: get_dependant analyzes a callable into a Dependant (fastapi/dependencies/models.py), and solve_dependencies walks that tree per request, caching sub-dependencies, handling generator dependencies with an AsyncExitStack and collecting validation errors. The same analysis feeds both request handling and OpenAPI generation.

nodes.name: Requests, responses & errors
nodes.summary: The request and response types, JSON encoding of arbitrary Python objects, upload and form handling, streaming responses, and the exception handlers that turn errors into HTTP responses.
nodes.detail: fastapi/encoders.py (jsonable_encoder) converts Pydantic models, dataclasses, enums, datetimes and more into JSON-safe primitives — the heart of response serialization. fastapi/responses.py and fastapi/requests.py re-export and extend Starlette types; fastapi/datastructures.py adds UploadFile and typed form/header containers; fastapi/sse.py streams Server-Sent Events. fastapi/exceptions.py defines HTTPException, WebSocketException, RequestValidationError and friends, and fastapi/exception_handlers.py renders them. fastapi/testclient.py, templating.py and staticfiles.py re-export the Starlette test client and template/static helpers.

nodes.name: OpenAPI & docs
nodes.summary: Generates the OpenAPI schema from the collected routes and their dependency trees, and serves the Swagger UI and ReDoc pages that render it.
nodes.detail: fastapi/openapi/utils.py walks every route, derives path, parameter, request-body and response schemas from each route's Dependant and response model, and assembles the full OpenAPI document; fastapi/openapi/models.py is the Pydantic model of the OpenAPI specification it builds. fastapi/openapi/docs.py returns the small HTML pages that load Swagger UI and ReDoc from a CDN and point them at the generated schema. The result is cached on the app and re-served on every docs request.

nodes.name: Security schemes
nodes.summary: Dependency classes for the common authentication schemes — OAuth2, API keys, HTTP Basic/Bearer/Digest and OpenID Connect — that both guard endpoints and describe themselves in OpenAPI.
nodes.detail: Each class under fastapi/security/ is a callable dependency: used in an endpoint signature it extracts and checks a credential from the request (an Authorization header, a cookie, a query parameter), raising 401/403 on failure, and it also carries the SecurityScheme metadata that fastapi/openapi/utils.py reads to document the scheme. fastapi/security/oauth2.py implements the password and authorization-code flows and the form bodies they expect; api_key.py, http.py and open_id_connect_url.py cover the other schemes; utils.py holds shared header parsing.

nodes.name: Internals: compat, middleware & telemetry
nodes.summary: The Pydantic-compatibility layer, the middleware wrappers FastAPI re-exports, and the built-in OpenTelemetry instrumentation.
nodes.detail: fastapi/_compat/ isolates the rest of the code from Pydantic internals — building field validators, running validation and extracting schemas through one shared interface (the codebase now targets Pydantic v2). fastapi/middleware/ re-exports Starlette middleware (CORS, GZip, trusted-host, HTTPS-redirect, WSGI) plus the AsyncExitStack middleware that scopes generator dependencies to the request. fastapi/telemetry/ auto-configures OpenTelemetry tracing, metrics and logs from environment variables at ASGI lifespan startup and exports them over OTLP. fastapi/utils.py holds assorted shared helpers.

nodes.name: Upstream libraries
nodes.summary: The libraries FastAPI is built on and always requires.

nodes.name: Optional integrations
nodes.summary: Extras pulled in by fastapi[standard] for the dev server, templates, forms, email validation and the test client.

nodes.name: Network endpoints
nodes.summary: The CDN that serves the docs UI assets and the OpenTelemetry collector telemetry is exported to.

nodes.name: Starlette
nodes.summary: The ASGI toolkit FastAPI subclasses: routing, requests/responses, middleware, WebSockets and the test client all build on it.

nodes.name: Pydantic
nodes.summary: Validates request data and serializes responses from type hints, and supplies the models the OpenAPI schema is built from (v2 required).

nodes.name: AnyIO
nodes.summary: Async compatibility layer used to run sync endpoints and dependencies in a worker threadpool.

nodes.name: OpenTelemetry API
nodes.summary: The tracing, metrics and logs API FastAPI's built-in telemetry records against; the SDK and OTLP exporter come from the opentelemetry extra.

nodes.name: Uvicorn
nodes.summary: The ASGI server the fastapi-cli commands launch to actually run the app.

nodes.name: fastapi-cli
nodes.summary: Separate package that implements the `fastapi dev` and `fastapi run` commands that fastapi/cli.py delegates to.

nodes.name: Jinja2
nodes.summary: Template engine behind Jinja2Templates for server-rendered HTML responses.

nodes.name: python-multipart
nodes.summary: Parses multipart and urlencoded form bodies and file uploads.

nodes.name: HTTPX
nodes.summary: HTTP client that backs TestClient, driving the app in-process during tests.

nodes.name: email-validator
nodes.summary: Validates EmailStr fields when email types are used in models.

nodes.name: Docs UI CDN
nodes.summary: jsDelivr CDN that serves the Swagger UI and ReDoc JavaScript and CSS the generated docs pages load by default.

nodes.name: OTLP collector
nodes.summary: OpenTelemetry collector endpoint (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT) that auto-configured traces, metrics and logs are exported to over HTTP.
